items: Latest-year cash is similar: Ford $23.4B and GM $20.9B. Ford's cash has stayed between $20.5B and $25.1B since FY2021, and GM's between $18.9B and $20.9B.
Ford's shareholders' equity fell to $36.0B in FY2025 from $44.8B in FY2024. GM's equity moved from $63.1B to $61.1B over the same year.
Ford's total liabilities were $253.2B against total assets of $289.2B. GM's were $218.1B against $281.3B.
Ford does not report long-term debt, so its long-term debt to equity is n/r. GM's rose from 1.84× in FY2021 to 2.15× in FY2025, so the two debt cushions cannot be compared directly.
Ford's FY2025 operating income was −$9.2B and GM's was $2.9B. Ford paid $3.0B in dividends and no buybacks, while GM paid $657M in dividends and $6.0B in buybacks.

Ford vs GM: cushion against a bad year

Two Detroit automakers, FY2021 to FY2025, compared on cash, balance-sheet weight and cash paid out.

FordGM

All years

n/r: not reported in the filing. n/m: not meaningful.

Where gaps and definitions come from

Ford does not report long-term debt, so its long-term debt to equity is n/r for every year. Neither company reports gross profit. Cash runway is n/m for both companies in all years, so no runway comparison is made. Both fiscal years end 12-31, so the years line up directly.

Takeaways

  • GM reports long-term debt every year and its ratio to equity rose in four of five years, while Ford's debt and ratio are n/r and cannot be compared.
  • Ford's FY2025 operating income of −$9.2B and net income of −$8.2B contrast with GM's positive $2.9B operating income and $2.7B net income that year.
  • GM's buybacks reached $11.1B in FY2023, while Ford's largest was $484M in FY2022; Ford's largest dividend year was $5.0B in FY2023 against GM's $657M in FY2025.
  • Operating cash flow in FY2025 was $21.3B at Ford and $26.9B at GM, with free cash flow of $12.5B and $17.6B.
  • Total liabilities grew at both companies over the period, from $208.4B (Ford) and $178.9B (GM) in FY2021 to $253.2B and $218.1B in FY2025.

Not financial advice.

Source: each company's 10-K filings, FY2021 to FY2025.
